newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine state mortgage bank gross $302 mln '96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine state mortgage bank gross $302 mln '96.

text.p: Argentine's state mortgage bank, Banco Hipotecario, estimated its gross full-year profit will be $302 million compared with gross profits of $327 in 1995, the bank said in a statement Friday.
Of the $302 million, the bank will transfer $46 million to the state and pay another $37 million in tax, the bank estimated, with just a few days left of its 1996 fiscal year.
The bank said that the drop in gross profits from 1995 was due to the decline in its lending rates.
Still the bank, which is scheduled to be privatized in the coming year, said its portfolio of mortgage loans more than doubled to $800 million this year from 1995.
